summary: Replay transport/export review found 2 critical defects: (1) seek range is fully controlled by climbTick with no local scrub value, so pointer scrubbing fights per-tick React updates while playing and onPointerUp often seeks the pre-drag tick; (2) AC-18 visibility pause stops the encode step loop but never pauses MediaRecorder/captureStream, so hidden time inflates video duration past AC-14 N/30±1s. Plus warnings on live key preventDefault during replay, export announce-before-fail, and seek clamp max=N. loopBackTo implementer.
goal: Climb replay should allow fast forwarding, rewind, pause/play. Export as mp4.

findings.issue: Seek <input type="range"> is controlled solely by transport.climbTick (`value={ratio}`) while scrubbing only sets a ref and defers onSeek to pointerup (and skips onChange while scrubbing). Spec requires scrub-then-commit (spec Speeds/seek table; AC-7). While the replay is playing, useClimb publishes match/transport every tick, so React resets the thumb to the advancing climbTick and the pointerup read of e.target.value is typically the pre-drag position — seek becomes a no-op. This breaks S2/AC-7 for the default autoplaying replay.
findings.fix: Keep a local scrub ratio state (or uncontrolled defaultValue + commit on pointerup/change). While pointer-down, bind value to the local ratio; on pointerup/commit call onSeek(tickFromSeekRatio(local, totalTicks)) then clear local so the control tracks transport again. Add a production-invoking unit or RTL test that commits a mid-drag ratio to a tick ≠ climbTick.

findings.issue: AC-18 policy (b) pauses the paint/step loop after document.hidden ≥3s, but canvas.captureStream(30) + MediaRecorder keep running. captureStream continues emitting the frozen canvas at 30fps for the entire hidden wall-clock interval, so exported duration becomes (simTicks/30 + hiddenSeconds) and violates AC-14’s N/30 ±1s envelope whenever the user backgrounds the tab mid-export — the exact case AC-18 exists to handle.
findings.fix: When entering paused_hidden, call MediaRecorder.pause() if state==='recording' (and optionally stop requesting new frames). On visibility visible, MediaRecorder.resume() then continue the encode loop. Guard browsers without pause/resume by stopping tracks or failing closed with AC-19 rather than silently padding duration. Cover with a unit that injects a fake recorder and asserts pause() on hidden≥3s / resume() on visible.

findings.issue: During replay, the live shouldCaptureGameKey window listener still preventDefaults Space and arrows in countdown/climb even though sampleInput is unused. Replay Space/k correctly toggles pause via a second listener, but arrow keys still swallow page scroll and Space is double-handled. AC-20 only locks the non-replay path; replay UX regresses scrolling around the stage (known prior Space/arrow incident class from learnings).
findings.fix: When replayInputs are active, skip live key capture entirely (or gate PHASES_CONSUMING_INPUT / shouldCaptureGameKey on !replaying) so only shouldCaptureReplayKey owns preventDefault during shared replay.

findings.issue: Export button always speak("Export started") after onExport(), even when startExport synchronously sets kind:"error" (unsupported MIME / no captureStream). aria-live then announces a false start before the error (AC-17).
findings.fix: Announce only from exportStatus transitions (running → "Export started"; error/success already handled in the exportStatus effect). Remove the optimistic speak in onClick.

findings.issue: seek() clamps target to [0, N] (inputs.length) rather than architecture/AC-7 [0, N−1]. tickFromSeekRatio is correct, but seekToTick(N) / any caller past the last climb index can step one past the normative tick domain.
findings.fix: Clamp with Math.max(0, n - 1) (or document finished-at-N as intentional and align AC-7/tests). Add a unit asserting seek(n) === seek(n-1) or equals the N−1 oracle.

findings.issue: downloadBlob revokes the object URL synchronously after a.click(). Some browsers cancel the download when the blob URL is revoked immediately, causing intermittent missing files after a successful encode (AC-15).
findings.fix: Revoke on a short delay (e.g. setTimeout 0–1000ms) or on the anchor’s click timeout; keep revoke on unmount/cancel paths.

findings.issue: Architecture allows forward-seek in place when target−current ≤ SNAPSHOT_INTERVAL_TICKS; implementation always clones from floor snapshot. Correctness OK (parity tests pass); minor extra clone/step cost only.
findings.fix: Optional: if current viewer state is available and target is ahead within one interval, step in place without cache clone. Not merge-blocking.

findings.issue: Verifier residual: exportPercent and filename builders are private — AC-15/16 cannot be unit-invoked. Non-test callers for new modules confirmed; new tests invoke production units (no source greps).
findings.fix: If tightening before QA, extract buildExportFilename + exportPercent next to pickExportMime; otherwise leave for browser QA-acceptance.

feedback.message: Seek scrub broken while playing — controlled range with no local scrub state
feedback.action: Add local scrub ratio; commit on pointerup via tickFromSeekRatio

feedback.message: Visibility pause does not pause MediaRecorder/captureStream — duration pads with frozen frames

learnings.insight: A controlled range input whose value is bound to live playback position cannot scrub: per-tick React updates reset the thumb, and commit-on-pointerup then reads the pre-drag value. Seek-on-release still needs local scrub state (or uncontrolled value) while the pointer is down.
learnings.action: For any scrub/seek control driven by a moving media clock, keep draft local value during pointer capture and commit once; never bind value only to the advancing clock while scrubbing.

learnings.insight: Pausing an encode rAF/step loop is not enough when canvas.captureStream is feeding MediaRecorder — the stream keeps sampling the last bitmap at the capture fps, so tab-hide time becomes frozen padding in the file and breaks duration contracts.
learnings.action: Whenever export visibility policy pauses encoding, also MediaRecorder.pause() (and resume on visible); assert pause/resume in a fake-recorder unit.

learnings.insight: Reviewer re-ran 24 production-invoking replay unit tests (transport/snapshots/mime/useClimb predicates) — all green; 2 critical + 4 warning + 2 info findings. Critical count blocks merge → needs_revision.
learnings.action: Treat criticalCount=2 as the revision gate; do not advance to qa-acceptance until seek scrub + MediaRecorder visibility pause are fixed and re-verified.

appliedLearnings: Did not treat source greps or AC-10/MediaRecorder browser residuals alone as critical
Checked write-on-read / trust: export is client download only; no climb/result touch
Did not expand into untouched files or implement fixes
